title: PWM Generator (Vienna Rectifier)
text: Vienna rectifier pulse-width modulation waveform generator, 4 inputs, 1 output, {Sampling mode} sets Wave sampling method; {Switching frequency (Hz)} sets the switching rate 1e3 and {Sample time (s)} sets the block sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.values: Block sample time 5e-5 s (default) | positive number
